===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''===
In ''[[JN037|That New Old Gang of Mine!]]'', Burnet greeted Ash upon his arrival in Alola and met [[Goh]], and introduced the former to her newborn son [[Lei]].

In ''[[JN112|Helping the Hometown Hero!]]'', Burnet with her family attended a party to celebrate the return of Lusamine and her family to Alola after they found Mohn. Burnet also reunited with Ash and Goh, and met [[Chloe]]. The next day, Burnet and Lei watched a [[Battle Royal]] match between Professor Kukui, Ash, Kiawe, and Gladion.

In ''[[JN131|Paring Pokémon While Parrying!]]'' and ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'', Burnet was seen watching Ash's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{an|Leon}} at the [[Pokémon School]].
